import { getAccessToken } from "/src/api/authSession.js";
import { PREP_CENTER_API_BASE } from "/src/features/teacher-prep-center/api/prepCenterApi.ts";
function authHeader() {
  const token = getAccessToken();
  return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
}
export function openPrepEventStream(sessionId, handlers) {
  let controller = null;
  let closed = false;
  let lastSeq = 0;
  let attempts = 0;
  const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 8;
  async function connect() {
    while (!closed && attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
      controller = new AbortController();
      handlers.onStatus?.(attempts === 0 ? "connecting" : "reconnecting");
      try {
        const res = await fetch(
          `${PREP_CENTER_API_BASE}/conversations/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/events`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            headers: {
              Accept: "text/event-stream",
              "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
              ...lastSeq > 0 ? { "Last-Event-ID": String(lastSeq) } : {},
              ...authHeader()
            },
            signal: controller.signal
          }
        );
        if (!res.ok || !res.body) {
          throw new Error(`sse connect failed: ${res.status}`);
        }
        attempts = 0;
        handlers.onStatus?.("open");
        const reader = res.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8");
        let buffer = "";
        for (; ; ) {
          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
          if (done) break;
          buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
          let sep;
          while ((sep = buffer.indexOf("\n\n")) >= 0) {
            const rawBlock = buffer.slice(0, sep);
            buffer = buffer.slice(sep + 2);
            handleBlock(rawBlock);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (closed || err?.name === "AbortError") return;
        handlers.onStatus?.("reconnecting");
        handlers.onError?.(err);
      }
      attempts += 1;
      if (!closed && attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.min(600 * 2 ** attempts, 5e3)));
      }
    }
  }
  function handleBlock(rawBlock) {
    let eventName = "";
    const dataLines = [];
    let id = null;
    for (const line of rawBlock.split("\n")) {
      if (!line || line.startsWith(":")) continue;
      if (line.startsWith("event:")) eventName = line.slice(6).trim();
      else if (line.startsWith("data:")) dataLines.push(line.slice(5).trimStart());
      else if (line.startsWith("id:")) id = line.slice(3).trim();
    }
    if (id) {
      const n = Number(id);
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > lastSeq) lastSeq = n;
    }
    if (!dataLines.length) return;
    let data;
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(dataLines.join("\n"));
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    if (closed) return;
    if (eventName === "snapshot") {
      handlers.onSnapshot?.(data);
      return;
    }
    if (eventName === "event" && data && typeof data === "object" && "event_type" in data) {
      handlers.onEvent?.(data);
    }
  }
  void connect();
  return {
    sessionId,
    close() {
      closed = true;
      controller?.abort();
      controller = null;
      handlers.onStatus?.("closed");
    }
  };
}
